Nia Roberts: did a 90-day recurrence pass (MayJul) focusing on incidents that hit SLAs or caused customer tickets. pulled signatures + short counts. proposing owners and short timelines so we can close the loop. full notebook: https://redwood-internal/notes/recurrence-90d-2026

Carlos Mendes: drop the top 5 signatures + counts so we can prioritize please.

Nia Roberts: quick table from the scan:

```
signature | incidents
KV_EVICTION_STORM | 22
FALLBACK_ROLLOUT_LOOP | 14
GRPC_KEEPALIVE_RESET | 9
AUTOSCALER_SPURT_DROP | 6
```

Selina Park: i'll take KV_EVICTION_STORM. plan: per-tenant eviction caps, adaptive TTLs for hot prefixes, and eviction-latency dashboards. will add feature flag + load tests. ETA 3w (2026-08-12).

Carlos Mendes: i'll own FALLBACK_ROLLOUT_LOOP. remediation: add rollout cooldown, per-pool hysteresis, and console gating to pause if fallback rate >4% for 5m. will include an eval prompt set for canaries. ETA 2w (2026-08-05).

Nia Roberts: i've opened epic INC-4810: "90d recurrence remediations May-Jul" and seeded tickets. ops-bot, create epic and tag recurrence-scan + triage-weekly.

ops-bot: Created epic INC-4810: "90d recurrence remediations May-Jul" labels: recurrence-scan, triage-weekly. https://jira.local/browse/INC-4810

Carlos Mendes: note on fallback gating: need an emergency bypass for critical security patch rollouts. will implement manual-approval path with audit log.
